verdict.rationale: FireHydrant Signals documents ingesting events from monitoring tools, including a generic webhook event source with a defined Event Format. Teams configure Alert Rules with CEL conditions, which can be backtested, and matching events become Alerts routed to the right party via escalation policies and team on-call schedules. Missing for 10: no enumerated list of named native monitoring-tool sources in the evidence, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of routing behavior.
